articles.summary: PR Newswire: ITI's The Intersect Tech Policy Summit Happening in Washington D.C. on February 3rd. Next Tuesday, February 3rd, global tech trade association ITI will bring together top tech and government leaders to explore how America will chart its course in the global tech race. The Intersect will take place on February 3 from 11am – 4pm ET in Washington, DC. Register here. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN.
